heard: Jacob's children gathered round, Asher stood among the sons Imna first and Ishva there, Ishvi named in ancient lands Beriah walked with them all, and his sister Sarah too Her name was kept in holy text, part of Jacob's house of two The sons of Asher, by their friends, from Himnathim, nightline From Ishvi, the Ishvite name, from Pariah, the Beriet-Shine Sarah was the daughter's name, recorded in the census plain Seventy souls went down to stay in the land of Egypt's grave
